batch.assignment: Exactly eight D1312-bound saved PNGs, one open each, no other images
batch.method: Each listed saved file was hash/byte-bound to D1312 before a single view_image call. Observations derive from those eight actual tool-returned images. PNG header dimensions were read without generating new media.

images.purpose: Whole-course layout, figure/caption placement and closing-content visibility
images.observed: Centered prose column, separated paragraphs, both sequential apparatus figures and Figure 15/16 captions, followed by solid deformation and the final simple-gas limitation. No visible overlap, missing media, horizontal cutoff or truncated course ending. Duplicated chapter breadcrumb noted separately as nonblocking.
images.limit: Tall whole-page preview supports layout and end visibility, not all-glyph or every-line full-resolution certification.

images.purpose: Saved desktop viewport: title, opening definitions, prose/symbol visibility and spacing
images.observed: Title and opening equilibrium explanation are readable, with separated lines and paragraphs. Visible t, V and p render without missing-glyph boxes. No horizontal text clipping or incoherent overlap. The lower viewport boundary cuts off further scroll content normally, not the document.
images.limit: Legacy polarization filename contains a top-of-course thermodynamic-parameters viewport, not a separate heat-capacity or polarization image; it does not cover every later prose line.

images.purpose: Saved figure 15 pixel visibility at the reported desktop media width
images.observed: Tall narrow vessel, thermometer/bulb, stopper, pressure tube, scale and U-manometer are visible. All seven component labels fit and remain separate from the apparatus and image edge. No blank or clipped diagram.
images.limit: Visibility review of saved display pixels only; no new source geometry, exact tick, reading or dimension judgment.

images.purpose: Saved figure 16 pixel visibility at the reported desktop media width
images.observed: Broader rounded vessel remains visibly distinct from figure 15. The instruments and all seven labels are nonblank, unclipped and separated; the lower U-manometer label remains within the saved image.
images.limit: Saved-pixel legibility and framing, not renewed source fidelity or measured-state equivalence.

images.purpose: Whole-course mobile wrapping, figure/caption placement and closing-content visibility
images.observed: Prose wraps within the narrow column with consistent margins. Both apparatus figures and captions are placed after the gas discussion, followed by both closing paragraphs. The final simple-gas limitation is visible with whitespace below it. No overlapping paragraphs, missing figure, cropped side text or course-end cutoff. Duplicate breadcrumb noted as nonblocking.
images.limit: Tall preview cannot certify every fine glyph or every line at normal mobile resolution.

images.purpose: Saved mobile viewport: title, opening definitions, wrapping and visible temperature symbol
images.observed: Title fits; chapter breadcrumb wraps without overlap; opening gas states and equilibrium definition are readable with clear paragraph spacing. The temperature t line is visible at the bottom, not horizontally clipped. No missing-glyph boxes observed in this viewport.
images.limit: Top viewport only; the legacy filename does not imply separate coverage of every repaired definition.

images.purpose: Saved figure 15 label and media visibility at actual mobile width
images.observed: All seven English labels are visible and readable; thermometer/bulb, tall bottle, pressure tube, scale and lower bend fit. No label clipping, label-to-label collision or blank media.
images.limit: Fine instrument marks remain schematic and are not measured readings or a new source-pixel approval.

images.purpose: Saved figure 16 label and media visibility at actual mobile width
images.observed: Rounded vessel and all apparatus components fit; all seven English labels, including the bottom U-manometer label, remain readable and separate. No clipped bottom, missing object, label overlap or blank image.
images.limit: No source/science/figure-geometry re-review and no numerical inference from these saved pixels.

nonBlockingObservation: Both whole and viewport saves show the same Chapter 2 breadcrumb item twice. Pixel visibility/layout PASS does not conceal this minor presentation duplication.
